# NIQ Expands ConnectAI Charter Program with Mars Snacking


## Mars joins a growing group of global companies working with NIQ forward-deployed engineers to bring proprietary consumer and market intelligence into enterprise AI workflows


**CHICAGO, October 22, 2026 —** NielsenIQ (NYSE: NIQ), a leading consumer intelligence company, today announced Mars as a new ConnectAI Charter client, expanding the program’s growing roster of global companies working with NIQ to build the intelligence foundation for amplifying enterprise AI workflows.


Through the ConnectAI Charter Program, NIQ forward-deployed engineers and data scientists are working with Mars to embed NIQ intelligence in the expansion of AI-enabled workflows across its business. The engagement focuses on connecting NIQ data, models, and business context with Mars’ AI ecosystem to help reduce the distance between data and decision-making. Together, they are tackling use cases like conversational analytics and harmonized product data to lay the foundation for future use cases.


*“As we expand the use of AI across our business, we see an opportunity to bring decision-makers closer to insight and reduce the manual effort between data and action,” said* ***Rishi Padhi, SVP and Chief Digital and Information Officer, Mars.*** *“Through NIQ’s ConnectAI Charter Program, we’re exploring how Optiq Bridge, harmonization, and the semantic layer can create a more scalable foundation for AI-enabled workflows, with potential applications in areas such as demand forecasting and broader access to high-quality intelligence across the organization. By connecting data, context, and AI more effectively, we can help teams turn complex information into actionable insights faster.”*


---


## **ConnectAI Momentum Continues**


ConnectAI is an offering within NIQ’s “Intelligence that Fuels AI” strategy, which brings NIQ’s proprietary data, models, and business context into clients’ AI environments. Forward-deployed NIQ engineers and data scientists work alongside client teams to configure workflows, such as building agents, around their specific business priorities.


The model is designed to create repeatable platform services that can scale across organizations, use cases, and AI ecosystems while adapting to each client’s environment.


*“The companies creating value from AI are grounding it in trusted intelligence and putting it to work against real business priorities,” said* ***Irina Stoian, Chief AI Commercial Officer, NIQ*** *. “ConnectAI helps clients move from experimentation toward scalable implementation, connecting AI with the intelligence and business context needed to support more confident decisions and stronger execution.”*


NIQ plans to continue expanding the ConnectAI Charter Program, including additional engagements with brands and retailers. Companies interested in working with NIQ forward-deployed engineering and data science teams can express interest[here](https://nielseniq.com/global/en/landing-page/connectai/) .

## About NIQ


NielsenIQ (NYSE: NIQ) is a leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete and trusted understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. By combining an unmatched global data footprint and granular consumer and retail measurement with decades of AI modeling expertise, NIQ builds decision systems that help companies turn complex data into confident action.


With operations in more than 90 countries, NIQ covers approximately 82% of the world’s population and more than $7.4 trillion in global consumer spend. Through cloud-based platforms, advanced analytics and AI-driven insights, NIQ delivers The Full View™—helping brands and retailers understand what consumers buy, why they buy it, and what to do next.


For more information, please visit[www.niq.com.](https://www.niq.com/)
